subject: AWS Marketplace metering & fulfillment: billing lifecycle handoff and contract addendum
messages:
From: Alexa Mueller <alexa.mueller@orioncloud.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orioncloud.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: AWS Marketplace metering / fulfillment for OrionCloud SaaS contract

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the demo last week — the OrionCloud product & pricing map to Redwood's hosted offering pretty well. Procurement asked me to follow up on two specific items before we sign the SaaS contract addendum and proceed with a marketplace listing: 

1) End-to-end picture of how usage metering events will flow from our app -> AWS Marketplace (SaaS metering) -> Redwood billing and how entitlements are generated per account (we have per-customer orgs + shared tenant components).
2) Who owns invoicing reconciliation for marketplace-billed customers and the expected reconciliation files / cadence (monthly CSV/API).

I've attached a draft SOW for context. Can you send a short checklist of what Redwood needs from OrionCloud (API schema, entitlement mapping table, legal addendum language) and a proposed day for a technical kickoff?

Thanks,
Alexa
Alexa Mueller
Senior Procurement Manager, OrionCloud
attachments: OrionCloud_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alexa Mueller <alexa.mueller@orioncloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace metering / fulfillment for OrionCloud SaaS contract

Hi Alexa — great to hear. We're excited to get OrionCloud live in the Marketplace. Short answers up front and a proposed next step: 

- Flow: your app -> Redwood ingestion endpoint (we accept both direct MPX events and server-side metering) -> entitlement mapping -> AWS Marketplace fulfillment call (we handle SaaS entitlement API calls) -> billing export. We will provide a canonical usage-event schema and an entitlement mapping template keyed by your customer org_id.
- Reconciliation: Redwood produces a monthly usage CSV export and an API endpoint for reconciliation. For marketplace-billed customers, Redwood will push consolidated usage to AWS MPX and then provide a reconciled invoice file back to OrionCloud for internal accounting. We'd like the final ownership on customer-facing invoice lines to be agreed in the addendum (example language below).

What we need from you to start the technical onboarding (checklist):
- Example usage stream (sample events for 3 customers) and sample event frequency
- Entitlement mapping table (tenant ID -> MPX entitlement SKU)
- Legal addendum review: short clause for who owns invoice issuance and revenue recognition when Marketplace is the billing conduit
- PoC account for end-to-end validation

Proposed technical kickoff: Mon Dec 1, 2026 10:00 AM PT (30-45m). If that works, we'll loop in Ben for billing details and Marissa for fulfillment integration. I'll attach our short integration checklist.

Proposed addendum language (for legal to draft): "When AWS Marketplace handles invoicing, Redwood will supply usage and reconciliation files to OrionCloud within 5 business days of month close. OrionCloud owns customer-facing revenue recognition and is responsible for communicating price changes to Redwood 30 days in advance."

Thanks — I'll hold the kickoff invite pending your confirmation.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-mpx-integration-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Alexa Mueller <alexa.mueller@orioncloud.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 07:58:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace metering / fulfillment for OrionCloud SaaS contract

Sean — thanks for the clear checklist. Mon Dec 1 at 10:00 PT works for us. A couple quick clarifications before the call so procurement can prepare: 

- Entitlement mapping: we have two classes of customers (Enterprise and Team); both use the same org_id but Enterprise has seat-based add-ons. We'll prepare a mapping table showing core SKU + addon SKU mapping.
- Reconciliation cadence: monthly is acceptable. Procurement asked if Redwood can provide a delta file and a full monthly file (two files) — one for quick updates and one master for ledger ingestion.

We'll attach the sample events and mapping table before end of day Friday. I'll include our billing lead (procurement@orioncloud.com) on the kickoff invite.

Regards,
Alexa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Alexa Mueller <alexa.mueller@orioncloud.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace metering / fulfillment for OrionCloud SaaS contract

Team — looping in technical details ahead of today's kickoff at 10:00 PT. High-level implementation plan and open items (technical):

1) Event schema & ingestion: we'll accept either MPX-proxied events or direct POST to our /ingest/v1/usage endpoint. Key fields we need: timestamp, org_id, event_type, quantity, request_id (for dedupe), product_sku.
2) Deduplication: use request_id + hash of payload; keep 7-day window for retry dedupe. We need Orion to include a stable request_id.
3) Entitlement mapping: Marissa to own mapping table template. Karthik to review MPX SKU compatibility and produce a conversion matrix for seat-based addons.
4) Reconciliation & exports: Ben to own generating the monthly full file + delta file. Ben, what format do you prefer? CSV with invoice_id, org_id, line_item_sku, quantity, unit_price, period_start, period_end?

Attachments: mpx-event-schema.yaml (stub) — sample schema included for review.

Open questions for kickoff: 
- Is Orion's org_id stable across their shared-tenant resources? If not, we need to propose a compound key.
- Do they require a webhook for immediate entitlement issuance or is batch acceptable within 2 hours?

I'll bring a sample mapping spreadsheet to the call.

To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace metering / fulfillment for OrionCloud SaaS contract

Quick billing notes after review of Orion's draft SOW: 

- Format: CSV as proposed is fine; we'll produce a full monthly file plus a delta file (CSV). Will include invoice_id when available and a reconciliation_id tied to the hubspot deal.
- Proration & credits: need contractual language for retroactive credits if usage is over-billed due to duplicate events; propose a 45-day window for credit claims.
- Sample mapping request: can Orion provide 30 days of historical event samples (anonymized) so we can validate unit_price & rounding rules?

HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/OC-REDWOOD-2026-1293 
DocuSign addendum: https://docusign.com/req/0a7d5e2c

I'll draft the reconciliation CSV schema and post it to the shared Drive after the call.

—Ben
Billing Ops, Redwood Inference
